title: Paloma Business Plan Feature Matrix: Submission Channels, Batches and Corridors
content:
Each Paloma Business plan fixes how payouts may be submitted (on the web, by batch file, through the Paloma Business API), whether a batch file may be used and how many payout lines one batch may hold, whether payouts may be scheduled for a future release date, which corridors local-rail payouts reach, and whether SWIFT payouts to banks outside local rails are available.

| | Paloma Business Starter | Paloma Business Essentials | Paloma Business Growth | Paloma Business Pro | Paloma Business Scale | Paloma Business Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Submission channels | web | web | web, batch file | web, batch file, API | web, batch file, API | web, batch file, API |
| Batch payouts enabled | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Largest number of payout lines in one batch | 0 | 0 | 250 | 1000 | 5000 | 20000 |
| API access | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Scheduled payouts (future release date) | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| SWIFT payouts available | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

**Corridors served on local rails, identical on every plan:** MX-MXN, GT-GTQ, SV-USD, HN-HNL, DO-DOP, CO-COP, PH-PHP, IN-INR, VN-VND, BD-BDT, NG-NGN, KE-KES and GH-GHS.

### Notes to the matrix

1. A largest batch size of 0 lines means batches are not available on that plan (Paloma Business Starter and Paloma Business Essentials).
2. Paloma Business Starter is the only plan without scheduled payouts and without SWIFT payouts.
3. The API channel is listed only on the plans with API access: Paloma Business Pro, Scale and Enterprise.
